name: ADS Revit Toolbox
tagline: A pain-point study for a planned Revit productivity toolbox.
description: Market research for a general-purpose Revit productivity toolbox — the most-requested repetitive actions, ranked from Reddit, Autodesk forums, Quora, and plugin marketplaces, into a prioritised build list. Research phase, dated 2026-07-01; no code written yet.

page.objective: Work out which repetitive Revit actions are worth building one-click tools for, before writing any code.
page.problem: Common Revit actions take many steps and are repeated hundreds of times a week.
page.solution: A ranked list of the highest-frequency pain points, sourced from Reddit, Autodesk forums, Quora, and plugin marketplaces, to set the build order once development starts.

highlights.headline: A ranked catalog of Revit pain points, not yet a built tool.
points: Status: research phase, 2026-07-01 — README states "No code yet."
Pain points sourced from Reddit, Autodesk forums, Quora, and plugin marketplaces.
Plans to reuse AdsPhoenixL1's licensing and UI patterns once building starts.
